problems.problem: The generated thin ink rings no longer sit at shoulder height (previous version) but now read as flattened perspective ellipses whose arcs appear only at the left (~x55-200, y830-955) and right (~x880-1050, y830-955) margins, i.e. centered near y~890, while the two deterministic filled discs are centered at (540,1131) and the contact crop [370,920,710,1170] proves the true base plane at y=1060 with its soft contact shadow intact. Three different convergence altitudes (890 / 1060 / 1131) keep the 'grey world settles onto the red' event split, and the thin rings still stop short of the left and right canvas edges instead of cropping off all four sides as the concept's full-bleed gravity gesture requires.
problems.root_cause: background.prompt ring geometry was re-declared only verbally ('lower third'); the regenerated scene interpreted the rings as perspective floor ripples at mid-height instead of printed concentric circles co-centered with the deterministic disc stack at the base point.
problems.repair_strategy: Regenerate background with a prompt that forces flat printed concentric CIRCLES (not perspective ellipses) co-centered with the filled discs at (540,1131), running edge to edge and cropping off all four sides, on flat cardstock under cool even gallery light, no horizon, no objects, no equipment.

problems.problem: The deepened discs (#D8D4CD / #E1DED8 at 0.9) now read as deliberate printed ink (visible improvement over the previous near-invisible wash), but the bottle occupies only width ratio 0.1667 inside a ~930px disc field, so between the red band (~y660-770) and the disc rim the center still relies on a single small chromatic anchor; versus references 3 and 5, where the hero form or ripple system dominates the frame, the gravity event reads quiet rather than commanding.
problems.root_cause: Product scale kept at height ratio 0.4514 (legal under fresh_concept_size_policy 0.35-0.74) while the ripple field was enlarged; the size contrast between anchor and field was never re-balanced artistically.
problems.repair_strategy: Artistic resize within policy: enlarge product to height ratio ~0.55 (height ~792->900, width keeping source aspect ~256) with center_y = target_base_y - actual_height/2 so the base stays at 1060 and the whole bottle plus shadow remains inside canvas; keep the disc stack unchanged so convergence tightens on a stronger red anchor.

problems.problem: The bottom corner lockup is closer than before (subtitle now size 30 at bbox (648,1350)-(1007,1380), logo (86,1346)-(248,1370)) but the subtitle cap line still starts ~4px lower and its ink block ends 10px below the logo block, and its right margin (73px) no longer matches the logo's left margin (86px), so the intended symmetric corner colophon reads slightly slipped rather than locked.
problems.root_cause: Subtitle y was set to 1350 against logo y 1346 without compensating for the different font metrics (msyh vs ARIALN) and without mirroring the side margins.
problems.repair_strategy: Set subtitle.y to 1346 and subtitle.x to 994 (right edge 1080-86=994 margin mirror) keeping size 30 and exact copy, so both corner inks share one optical baseline and equal 86px side margins.
